sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: One Less Loose End is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, dear friend. There's an important job just for someone like you. You need to pick up a journal from the TerraGroup field lab at the Polikhim factory and drop it off at a specified location. It's at an old sawmill in Priozersk nature reserve. Leave the package at the house with transformers. I don't want to upset my influential customer, so I can't trust a random person with the job."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be Loyalty Level 2 to start this quest

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the lab journal on Factory
- Stash the journal at the old sawmill on Woods

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
- 550 Dollars
  - 578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3x CPU fan
- Unlock purchase of SIG MPX 9x19 submachine gun (Silenced) at Peacekeeper LL2
"Great! You know the saying "What happens in Vegas, stays in Vegas"? Everyone has their secrets, and prying into those secrets might be too dangerous..."

sections.heading: Failure Dialogue
sections.text: "Are you sure you did the right thing, mercenary? My client won't stand for it, and I'd recommend you look over your shoulder more often from now on. Don't count on me for protection."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Lab journal | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you first have to locate and obtain a journal in Factory. Afterwards it has to be stashed on Woods.

sections.heading: Factory journal location
sections.text: The journal can be found in the laboratory on the second floor. There are multiple spawns throughout both rooms.

sections.heading: Woods stashing location
sections.text: The journal has to be stashed inside a house at the old sawmill in the east of the location.
